register.labelZh: GO OFF 片語動詞的實際用途
register.labelEn: GO OFF Phrasal Verbs in Use
register.summaryZh: go off 可以表示某人離開,前往另一個地方或進行另一項活動。；go off somebody/something 可以表示你開始不喜歡某人、食物、活動或想法。；go off with somebody 可以表示某人離開伴侶,跟另一個人在一起。；go off with something 適合用來表示某人把物件拿走,可能沒有先問,或只是拿錯了。
register.summaryEn: Go off can show that someone leaves and moves on to another place or activity. Go off somebody/something helps you say that you are beginning to dislike a person, food, activity or idea. Go off with somebody can describe a person leaving a partner for somebody else. Go off with something is useful when somebody has taken an object away, perhaps without asking or by mistake.
